description: Downloads the code of a deployed app (kept with each deploy) into a new folder named after the app, inside "directory". Use it when the person wants to change an app whose code is not on this computer, for example one a coworker built. Only the app's owner or an admin can do this. Then work in that folder and deploy from it.

app.description: The app name, as in its address: <app>.<company>.teamonly.app

directory.description: Absolute path of the app's folder (the one with teamonly.json). Defaults to the folder the server started in.

version.description: Optional: a version number; default is the live one

name: pull
title: Download an app's code
